messages:
pagerduty-bot: 🔔 PAGER — High 5xx spike detected in production (api-prod) at 2026-03-15T14:03:20Z. Alert: 5xx rate > 6% for 60s on route cluster: api-gateway. Paging: @alex (on-call)

alex: on it — seeing the alert. paging into #incidents for visibility. Do we have a customer-facing impact yet?

infra-bot: Graphs: https://grafana.redwood/graph?panel=errors&from=2026-03-15T14:00Z to=2026-03-15T14:04Z — error rate jump from 0.5% -> 7.8% across region-us-east-1. Amplified on endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/stream.

alex: thanks. sam, maria, can you join? tagging @sam @maria — please check LB/Envoy.

sam: I’m looking. tailing gateway logs now. seeing repeated upstream 502/503 from backend-pool-2. But interestingly we have a ton of retries from envoy to the same upstream which seems to coincide with resource saturation.

maria: I see config change rolled ~14:00 by deploy-bot: route retry policy update for gateway (attempts: 3, per_try_timeout: 10s, retry_on: 5xx, gateway-errors). Could that be amplifying failures?

alex: copy. That would increase load if upstream is struggling. Can you paste the envoy route fragment?

sam: paste from admin/config_dump:```
{ "name": "api-route", "route": { "retry_policy": { "retry_on": "5xx,gateway-error", "num_retries": 3, "per_try_timeout": "10s" }, "timeout": "0s" } }
```

june: also seeing increased reject rate on circuit-breaker for cluster backend-pool-2: connections_overflow and pending_requests high. Circuit-breaker ejection counts rose right after the retry policy rollout.

alex: hypothesis: new retry_policy is causing request amplification (retries -> increased concurrency -> circuit-breaker tripping -> more 5xx). Mitigation path: reduce/disable retries at edge, add quick per_try_timeout drop, and lower max connections/pending for safe fallback. Can we hotpatch route to disable retries?

maria: yes — I can push a rollback to previous route that had no retries. It's a config map change in infra repo. I will prepare a hotfix.

eng-frontend: customer monitoring flagged increased 502s for several enterprise customers (acct: AcmeCorp, NovaHealth) — internal ticket created CS-3456. CX pinged.

alex: good to know customer scope. ops-lead, do we want to page CS and Sales?

ops-lead: yes. Sales/CS should be informed. Ops team please message affected accounts. Keep message factual: increased 5xx, mitigation in progress.

maria: rolling hotfix now — deploying config revert to remove retry_policy. Will do canary on 5% of gateways for 60s then 100% if stable. Command: ```kubectl apply -f gateway-route-revert.yaml --namespace=infra-prod && kubectl rollout status deploy/gateway -n infra-prod```

sam: while that's going, I’ll patch Envoy admin to lower per_try_timeout to 2s for remaining traffic to reduce hanging attempts. Use: admin/route-modify-api.

alex: note: we should also increase retry budget for client-side to avoid re-sending at app layer. But primary fix is removing retries at gateway.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: started rollout revert by maria at 2026-03-15T14:06:30Z. Canary 5% gateways. CI job: infra/gateway/revert-5180000000. Logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/5180000000

sam: checking logs, canary shows 5xx dropping from 8% -> 1.2% after revert began. Still seeing some transient 502s from unhealthy backend pods.

june: manual pod ejection happening on cluster side due to connection bursts; I've temporarily increased upstream connection pool size to smooth traffic while autoscaler stabilizes. Monitoring CPU on backend-pool-2.

eng-frontend: CX update sent: "We are investigating elevated 5xx errors and are rolling a mitigation now; customers may see intermittent 502/503 for the next 10–15 minutes."

alex: good. Anyone see errors in edge proxies or only gateway?

sam: edge proxies mostly pass-through. Problem looks concentrated in gateway -> backend-pool-2. Traffic shaping from LB might have concentrated too many sessions on that pool. We're checking load balancer weight config.

maria: revert completed to 100% at 2026-03-15T14:09:00Z. Post-revert metrics: total 5xx down to 0.9% cluster-wide within 2 minutes.

pagerduty-bot: Incident auto-signal: error rate back below threshold. Status: mitigated — monitoring for 30m.

alex: great. please keep monitoring for 30 minutes before closing. Next steps: postmortem and root cause. Initial RCA items: retry policy rollout without capacity check; LB weight shuffle concentrated traffic; circuit-breaker thresholds too aggressive for transient retry amplification.

ops-lead: assign postmortem to infra and runtime teams. Draft notes:
- Timeline of events (deploy -> surge -> circuit break -> rollback)
- Customer impact (tickets: CS-3456, *approx* 12 customers reported within window)
- Immediate mitigations (rollback of retry policy, connection pool tuning)
- Action items: add pre-deploy chaos/capacity test for retry policy changes; add automated canary metrics gate for 5xx and circuit-breaker ejections; update runbook for retry-induced amplification.

sam: collecting additional logs and correlating envoy admin stats; will upload to incident storage: https://incidents.redwood/5180000000/logs.

june: scheduling a short follow-up meeting in 30m for handoff to oncall-2. Please bring any relevant grafana panels and deploy history.

alex: noted. oncall-2: @maria will hand off. maria, can you add the exact config hash for the failing release to the incident doc?

maria: done — release tag: infra-gateway@a1b2c3d4, configmap hash: cfg-20260315-1400. Added to incident doc.

eng-frontend: confirming customers notified via status.redwood.com update. Also updating CS backlog.

ops-lead: good work. We'll keep this H1 incident in "mitigated" state until 14:39Z. Postmortem doc owner: sam.

alex: closing notes: 1) Don’t push new retry/gateway changes without canary gates. 2) Add an automated check that prevents enabling retries on routes with circuit-breaker ejection counts above X in the last 10m.

pagerduty-bot: Incident state: mitigated. Pager closed to on-call after 30m watch if no regression.

sam: uploading final traces and envoy admin snapshots.

june: handoff complete to oncall-2 at 2026-03-15T14:34:20Z.

ops-lead: Thank you all. Postmortem skeleton: https://docs.redwood/inci/postmortems/5180000000. Schedule will be set for tomorrow 09:30 PT.

alex: copy — I'll run the blameless postmortem and include dev, infra, runtime, and ops.

maria: I'll open a PR to lock retry_policy behind a feature flag + canary gate.

eng-frontend: keeping CS updated; customers acknowledged the update.

alex: good job team. ending thread.
